import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source6_7_0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source6_7_1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source6_7_2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source6_7_3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source6_7_4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source6_7_5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_5.csv", index_col=0)

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN : [["Source6_7_0", "Source6_7_1"], ["Id", "Id"]]
join_0_1 = pd.merge(
    source6_7_0, source6_7_1,
    on="Id",
    suffixes=("_x", "_y"),
    how="inner"
)

# 2) JOIN : [["Source6_7_2", "Source6_7_3"], ["Id", "Id"]]
join_2_3 = pd.merge(
    source6_7_2, source6_7_3,
    on="Id",
    suffixes=("_x_3", "_y_4"),
    how="inner"
)

# 3) JOIN : [["Source6_7_4", "Source6_7_5"], ["Id", "Id"]]
join_4_5 = pd.merge(
    source6_7_4, source6_7_5,
    on="Id",
    suffixes=("_x_5", "_y_6"),
    how="inner"
)

# Now join the three joined results on "Id" to form the final target table
# First join join_0_1 and join_2_3
temp_join = pd.merge(
    join_0_1, join_2_3,
    on="Id",
    how="inner"
)

# Then join the above result with join_4_5
target6_7 = pd.merge(
    temp_join, join_4_5,
    on="Id",
    how="inner"
)

# Calculate the final 'SalePrice' column as the average of all SalePrice columns
# Columns to average: SalePrice_x, SalePrice_y, SalePrice_x_3, SalePrice_y_4, SalePrice_x_5, SalePrice_y_6
saleprice_cols = [
    "SalePrice_x",
    "SalePrice_y",
    "SalePrice_x_3",
    "SalePrice_y_4",
    "SalePrice_x_5",
    "SalePrice_y_6"
]

# Ensure all these columns exist in target6_7 (they should, from merges)
target6_7["SalePrice"] = target6_7[saleprice_cols].mean(axis=1)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly:
# ['Id', 'SalePrice_x', 'SalePrice_y', 'SalePrice_x_3', 'SalePrice_y_4', 'SalePrice_x_5', 'SalePrice_y_6', 'SalePrice']
target6_7 = target6_7[
    ['Id', 'SalePrice_x', 'SalePrice_y', 'SalePrice_x_3', 'SalePrice_y_4', 'SalePrice_x_5', 'SalePrice_y_6', 'SalePrice']
]

# Cast columns to correct types as per target schema
target6_7 = target6_7.astype({
    'Id': 'int64',
    'SalePrice_x': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_x_3': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y_4': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_x_5': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y_6': 'float64',
    'SalePrice': 'float64'
})

# Write the result to the specified path
target6_7.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
